fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll esv::safe_position::TrackingSystem::ProcessNotSafePositionChanges iterates the event storage with stride 0x18, takes the EntityHandle at +0 and looks up that character's esv::SafePositionComponent; the event entity itself is destroyed. Live: entity-handle shaped values.

fields.name: Position
fields.evidence: Same function compares +8/+0xC/+0x10 with the SafePositionComponent's position and copies them into it. Live floats (world coordinates).
